label: Jaw depth

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #17 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: mandible height / L: 0.28 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.12 -> -100 = 0.16, +100 = 0.40 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.28) / 0.12)

region.mask_rule: jaw mesh (separate mesh on the base), ramus vertical scale; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Ramus height - the whole jaw depth under the ear, including the below-line body - as mandible height over L (lion +45, badger-class depth). Its pair is JawDepthProfile (head.jaw.depth_profile): #17 scales the jaw, #37 reshapes its above-line profile (spec section 5.4). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
